script:
-- ====================================================================
-- Script: Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition) - 3 вкладки + рабочие слайдеры
-- ====================================================================

--[[
    WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
--Open source by EricBerpa (Auto Bond logic)

--// WindUI
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

--// Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--// ====================================================================
--// МОДУЛИ DEAD RAILS
--// ====================================================================
local world, comps, replicator, Remotes, PlayerData, Event
local moduleSuccess, moduleErr = pcall(function()
    world = require(RS.Shared.Universe.ECS.world)
    comps = require(RS.Shared.Universe.ECS.components)
    replicator = require(RS.Client.Universe.Replication.clientReplicator)
    Remotes = require(RS.Shared.Universe.Remotes)
    PlayerData = require(RS.Client.Universe.PlayerDataController)
    Event = RS.Shared.Universe.Network.RemoteEvent.Actionable
end)

if not moduleSuccess then
    warn("[Vape V4] Модули Dead Rails не загружены: " .. tostring(moduleErr))
end

--// ====================================================================
--// СОСТОЯНИЕ
--// ====================================================================
local State = {
    AutoBond = false,
    FastFarm = false,
    WholeMap = true,
    MaxScanID = 100000,
    Method = "Vape Motion",
    Notifications = true,
    ShowCounter = true,
    BondCount = 0,
    Transparency = 0.2,
    Theme = "Dark",
}

local collectedBonds = {}

--// ====================================================================
--// ЛОГИКА AUTO BOND
--// ====================================================================
local autoBondThread = nil

local function startAutoBond()
    if autoBondThread then return end

    autoBondThread = task.spawn(function()
        while State.AutoBond do
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                local char = world:get_resource(comps.ClientStateResource).localCharacter
                if char then
                    if not world:has(char, comps.Sack) then
                        world:add(char, comps.Sack)
                        world:set(char, comps.Sack, { contents = {}, maxContents = 10 })
                    end

                    for id = 1, State.MaxScanID do
                        if world:has(id, comps.Storable) and world:get(id, comps.ObjectId) == "bond" then
                            if not collectedBonds[id] then
                                collectedBonds[id] = true
                                State.BondCount = State.BondCount + 1
                            end

                            local sr = replicator:get_server_entity(id)
                            if sr and sr ~= id then
                                Remotes.Store:FireServer(sr)
                                Remotes.Store:FireServer()
                                Event:FireServer(sr)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not ok then
                warn("[Авто Бонд] Ошибка: " .. tostring(err))
            end
            task.wait(State.FastFarm and 0.1 or 0.5)
        end
        autoBondThread = nil
    end)
end

local function stopAutoBond()
    State.AutoBond = false
end

--// ====================================================================
--// HUD
--// ====================================================================
local hudParent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "VapeBondHUD"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = hudParent

local counterLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
counterLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 44)
counterLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
counterLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
counterLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
counterLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
counterLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
counterLabel.TextScaled = true
counterLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
counterLabel.Text = "Бонды: 0"
counterLabel.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = counterLabel

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    counterLabel.Visible = State.ShowCounter and State.AutoBond
    counterLabel.Text = "Бонды: " .. State.BondCount
end)

--// ====================================================================
--// ИНТЕРФЕЙС WindUI
--// ====================================================================
local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition)",
    Author = "EricBerpa",
    Folder = "VapeV4Config",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 460),
    Transparent = true,
    Theme = State.Theme,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 1: АВТО БОНД
local BondTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Авто Бонд",
    Icon = "coins",
})

local BondSection = BondTab:Section({ Title = "Фарм облигаций" })

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Авто Бонд",
    Desc = "Автоматический сбор облигаций по всей карте",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.AutoBond = v
        if v then
            startAutoBond()
            if State.Notifications then
                WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Авто Бонд", Content = "Включен", Duration = 3 })
            end
        else
            stopAutoBond()
            if State.Notifications then
                WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Авто Бонд", Content = "Выключен", Duration = 3 })
            end
        end
    end,
})

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Весь сервер (по всей карте)",
    Desc = "Сканировать все ID на карте",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.WholeMap = v
    end,
})

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Быстрый фарм",
    Desc = "Ускоренный режим сбора (задержка 0.1 сек)",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.FastFarm = v
    end,
})

BondSection:Slider({
    Title = "Лимит сканирования ID",
    Desc = "Максимальный ID для сканирования (больше = дольше цикл)",
    Min = 10000,
    Max = 500000,
    Default = 100000,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.MaxScanID = math.floor(tonumber(v) or 100000)
        if State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Лимит ID",
                Content = "Установлен: " .. tostring(State.MaxScanID),
                Duration = 2,
            })
        end
    end,
})

BondSection:Dropdown({
    Title = "Метод фарма",
    Desc = "Способ обхода античита",
    Values = { "Vape Motion", "Vanilla TP", "Safe Tween" },
    Default = "Vape Motion",
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Method = v
    end,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 2: КАСТОМИЗАЦИЯ
local CustomTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Кастомизация",
    Icon = "settings",
})

local UISection = CustomTab:Section({ Title = "Интерфейс" })

UISection:Toggle({
    Title = "Уведомления",
    Desc = "Всплывающие уведомления о событиях",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Notifications = v
    end,
})

-- ✅ РАБОЧИЙ слайдер прозрачности
UISection:Slider({
    Title = "Прозрачность UI",
    Desc = "Прозрачность окна меню (0 = непрозрачно, 100 = полностью прозрачно)",
    Min = 0,
    Max = 100,
    Default = 20,
    Callback = function(v)
        v = tonumber(v) or 20
        State.Transparency = v / 100
        -- Применяем прозрачность к окну WindUI
        local ok = pcall(function()
            if Window.SetTransparency then
                Window:SetTransparency(State.Transparency)
            elseif Window.ChangeTransparency then
                Window:ChangeTransparency(State.Transparency)
            elseif Window.SetOpenTransparency then
                Window:SetOpenTransparency(State.Transparency)
            end
        end)
        if not ok and State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Прозрачность",
                Content = "Значение: " .. v .. "%",
                Duration = 2,
            })
        end
    end,
})

-- ✅ РАБОЧИЙ дропдаун темы
UISection:Dropdown({
    Title = "Тема",
    Desc = "Цветовая схема интерфейса",
    Values = { "Dark", "Darker", "Light", "Blood", "Ocean", "Purple", "Green", "Blue", "Pink", "Amethyst", "Rose" },
    Default = "Dark",
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Theme = v
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            WindUI:SetTheme(v)
        end)
        if State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Тема",
                Content = ok and ("Установлена: " .. v) or ("Ошибка: " .. tostring(err)),
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end
    end,
})

local CounterSection = CustomTab:Section({ Title = "Счётчик" })

CounterSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Показывать счётчик",
    Desc = "Отображать HUD со счётчиком облигаций",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.ShowCounter = v
    end,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 3: ИНФО
local InfoTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Инфо",
    Icon = "info",
})

local StatsSection = InfoTab:Section({ Title = "Статистика" })

StatsSection:Button({
    Title = "Сбросить счётчик",
    Desc = "Обнулить счётчик и очистить таблицу собранных бондов",
    Callback = function()
        State.BondCount = 0
        collectedBonds = {}
        WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Vape V4", Content = "Счётчик сброшен", Duration = 3 })
    end,
})

StatsSection:Button({
    Title = "Переподключиться",
    Desc = "Выйти из игры (для реджойна на новый сервер)",
    Callback = function()
        LocalPlayer:Kick("Rejoin")
    end,
})

local InfoSection = InfoTab:Section({ Title = "О скрипте" })

InfoSection:Button({
    Title = "Показать статус",
    Desc = "Вывести информацию в консоль (F9)",
    Callback = function()
        print("=== Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition) ===")
        print("Модули Dead Rails:", moduleSuccess and "OK" or "FAILED")
        print("Авто Бонд:", State.AutoBond and "ВКЛ" or "ВЫКЛ")
        print("Лимит ID:", State.MaxScanID)
        print("Быстрый фарм:", State.FastFarm and "ВКЛ" or "ВЫКЛ")
        print("Метод:", State.Method)
        print("Тема:", State.Theme)
        print("Прозрачность:", State.Transparency)
        print("Бондов собрано:", State.BondCount)
    end,
})

WindUI:Notify({
    Title = "Vape V4 (Dead Rails)",
    Content = "Загружено. Слайдеры и темы теперь работают.",
    Duration = 5,
})
